name: file-manager
description: Standardize dataset downloads and post-processing inside a user-specified data directory.

interface.shortDescription: Normalize raw and processed dataset files
interface.longDescription: Keep downloaded datasets, processing scripts, logs, and outputs in a normalized data tree for single- or multi-dataset model-development workflows.
defaultPrompt: Download this dataset into the specified data directory, then process it as requested.
Normalize the existing single-dataset files under this data directory.
Prepare separate raw and processed workflows for multiple datasets in this data directory.
